---
name: format-change-log
description: Formats CHANGELOG.md entries for releases. Use whenever you add a release note to CHANGELOG.md, so entries stay in the house style.
---

# Format a changelog entry

1. Read the latest entry in `CHANGELOG.md` to see the current heading style
   (`## [semver] - YYYY-MM-DD`).
2. Add the new entry at the top with one bullet per user-visible change.
3. Never edit older entries.
